name: Sable Rock Manor
description: Six-bedroom private lodge in Caldera Springs, Sunriver, with nine fireplaces, a game room and a twelve-person hot tub under the pines.
cardDescription: Six-bedroom private lodge in Caldera Springs, Sunriver, with nine fireplaces, a game room and a twelve-person hot tub under the pines.
capacityDetails: Six bedrooms, thirteen beds, sleeps fourteen (own homepage); children 5 and under do not count toward occupancy (rental terms).
kidsDetails: Children welcome: rental terms say children 5 years old or younger do not count toward occupancy; guest of record must be 23+.
petsDetails: Rental terms section 08: "Pets are strictly prohibited."
